The '''Seario Memorial Showroom''' was a venue located in the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] facility on the moon, [[CZ-198]] in the [[Czerka Corporate Labs]] during the era of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Named after the [[President/Legends|President]] of Czerka Corporation during the era of the [[Jedi Civil War]], [[Pollard Seario]], the showroom presented the technology and innovative consumer products researched and produced in the facility.<ref name="Flashpoint" />

Products presented at the Showroom included the [[Czerka tripod battledroid]], [[Czerka Mining droid]], [[Czerka Probe drood]], [[VX-5 Ricker]], and [[Executive Cruiser]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />
